verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows are triggered by webhooks, schedules, email, RSS, or app events and run autonomously with retry/error-handling and email alerts, requiring no manual invocation once deployed. Docs also show AI agent deployment ('Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds') and code execution in Node.js/Python/Go/Bash for background automation logic. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of long-running autonomous agent behavior and more detail on scheduling reliability at scale.
